size.$description: Sizes of things. 1px is 1dp on Android and 1pt on Apple platforms.

border.$description: A hairline outline, such as a text field's.

control.$description: The least height of something tapped, such as a button or a text field: Apple's and Android's minimum touch target.

content-max.$description: The widest a page's content gets, centred, on a tablet or an open foldable.

icon-sm.$description: An icon in a line of small text, such as a folder's state.

icon-md.$description: An icon in a button or a banner.

icon-lg.$description: An icon on its own, such as in a top bar or an action row.

tile-sm.$description: The mark beside the app's name.

tile-md.$description: An icon tile leading a row, such as a file's.

tile-lg.$description: An icon tile leading a card, such as a folder's.

hero.$description: The mark or icon at the top of a page that stands alone, or of an empty page.
